SearchFormDefinition.name: SearchDefRoleCommodityProfileMapping
SearchFormDefinition.Source: select r.roleId,cp.profileName,be.businessEntityIdentifier,be.businessEntityName,be.businessEntityTypeName,r.roleKey,be.businessEntityKey from RoleCommodityProfileMapping rcpm join rcpm.role r join rcpm.commodityProfile cp join rcpm.businessEntity be
SearchFormDefinition.ExtractSource: select r.roleId,cp.profileName,be.businessEntityIdentifier,be.businessEntityName,be.businessEntityTypeName from RoleCommodityProfileMapping rcpm join rcpm.role r join rcpm.commodityProfile cp join rcpm.businessEntity be

Text.name: profileName
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from CommodityProfile commProf join commProf.itemCategory ic where cp.itemCategory = ic and lower(cp.profileName) like lower(:profileName))

Text.name: companyItemType
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from CommodityProfile commProf join commProf.itemCategory ic where cp.itemCategory = ic and lower(cp.companyItemType) like lower(:companyItemType))

Text.name: categoryName
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from CommodityProfile commProf join commProf.itemCategory ic where cp.itemCategory = ic and lower(ic.categoryName) like lower(:categoryName))

Text.name: categoryIdentifier
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from CommodityProfile commProf join commProf.itemCategory ic where cp.itemCategory = ic and lower(ic.categoryId) like lower(:categoryIdentifier))
